runtime.health: ready: SingleStore, inmemory authorization, messaging Healthy

requirements.title: Independent product and variant selection with real human labels
positive: Catalog product picker is a separate server-searched list; variants load only for the selected product.
Variant dialog displays real Catalog axis labels (e.g. رنگ: آبی · سایز: ۳۲) and keeps CatalogCode only as secondary text.
Single-variant products auto-select with an explicit note; zero-variant products show a clear message.
Product change clears the previous variant; selecting a variant from another product is rejected in the UI.
Real product media is shown when PrimaryMediaAssetId exists.
negative: No auto product/variant selection on opening the form.
A variant cannot remain selected after its product changes.
boundary: Empty variant list produces a readable empty state rather than a technical code.

requirements.title: Standard modal pickers
positive: Seller, product and variant pickers are modal dialogs with search, paging, current selection, loading, error and empty states.
Selection closes the dialog and does not expand the form height.
Keyboard Enter searches; native dialog Escape closes; mobile width remains overflow-free.
negative: Pickers no longer render inline panels that push the form apart.
boundary: Selection survives paging in both directions (mount test).

requirements.title: Layout, alignment, header and readable text
positive: Header now uses a container query (3-column + dedicated price row below 1180px content width, 4-column above) instead of an unbalanced 4-column squeeze at 1440 with the panel sidebar.
Controls share the 37px height; labels/hints are aligned; field hints are 13px; footer/contrast improved.
Page and form have zero horizontal overflow at 360/768/1440.
The approved R7/295 visual structure (sticky header, seven tabs, cards) is preserved.
negative: No theme change and no parallel form architecture.
boundary: Owner final visual acceptance of remaining tabs remains external; only owner-reported findings were repaired.
evidence: evidence/r8-runtime/impeccable-detect-url.json (workspace: one advisory straggler; tiny-text findings resolved)

requirements.title: Create flow and tab locks
positive: Tabs explain whether identity is incomplete or the draft has not been saved.
Identity-valid create saves a real Draft, receives a real offerId, navigates to edit and enables allowed tabs.
No record is created when the form opens; creation is explicit and idempotent via requestId.
Create failure preserves seller/product/variant/SKU selections.
negative: Rapid double submit creates exactly one draft (mount test).
Create is disabled while an existing active/conflicting listing is known.
boundary: Admin and seller panel real creates both verified with independent API re-read.

requirements.title: Duplicate active offer and save errors
positive: Real cause is the existing non-archived seller+variant+channel listing; the constraint was preserved.
A read-only active-listing lookup returns the existing offer and the create form links to it.
Duplicate copy is natural Persian/English, never exposes offer.listing.duplicate_active, and has no meaningless retry.
Network failures are separated from validation/business conflicts and offer reload instead of blind retry.
negative: Seller panel duplicate test shows the conflict banner, existing-offer link and disabled submit.
Non-duplicate admin and seller creates succeed.
boundary: Lookup is seller-scoped for seller callers and admin-authorized for admin callers.

requirements.title: Real multilingual support
positive: Offer workspace receives the active locale definition (code/culture/direction/calendar) and its message catalog; it no longer coerces non-English to Persian.
Titles, fields, tabs, messages, errors, filters, column headers and actions are catalog-driven for fa/en.
Direction comes from the active locale; numbers, grouping, currency names and dates use the active culture/calendar.
Browser fa and en runtime proven; language navigation preserves unsaved draft/selections via session recovery.
An isolated third-language registry definition (tr-TR) proves direction/copy/fallback without changing the live registry; fixture test only.
negative: Unknown locale copy falls back to the project default catalog, never to a raw machine code.
boundary: Shared AppDataGrid chrome remains governed by the existing shared grid locale API (fa/en); the offer-owned columns/actions/copy are translated. Changing shared grid infrastructure was explicitly out of scope.

requirements.title: Number and amount standard
positive: Persian display numbers use Persian digits and grouping; tabs, counters, stock and results use the active formatter.
Amount input normalizes Persian/English digits, supports grouping, paste, deletion, selection and cursor restore.
IRR save rejects decimals; SKU/UUID/CatalogCode remain semantically unchanged.
Empty amount is blocked and never saved as zero; explicit zero is allowed by the real Pricing contract (model test).
negative: Legacy decimal price is warned about and not auto-changed.
boundary: Persian input ۱۲۳۴۵۶۷ persisted as 1234567; empty input left the persisted amount unchanged.
evidence: lib/offer-workspace/model.test.ts (Persian/Arabic normalization, IRR decimals, zero policy)

requirements.title: Independent inventory location saving
positive: A successful warehouse save updates only that StockItemId draft; other drafts and the reason remain untouched.
A later failure keeps the failed warehouse input and reason; retry executes only remaining locations and creates no duplicate adjustment.
StockItemId ownership, reserved quantities and other locations are preserved.
negative: The staged mount test fails the second warehouse after the first succeeds and asserts the first saved value plus the second retained draft.
Second save calls only the remaining location.
boundary: Runtime has one inventory location on the available seeded offer; multi-location partial failure is proven by the real mounted component test, and runtime single-location save/restore is independently re-read.

requirements.title: Save safety and error handling
positive: Save/create paths use try/catch/finally and a synchronous lock; no stuck saving state; double submit is blocked.
Partial failures preserve unsaved input; complete, partial, failed and uncertain outcomes are distinguished.
Connection loss shows an uncertain-result message, removes retry, and offers explicit server-state reload.
A stale snapshot reread blocks overwriting another session; draft remains available for review.
negative: No automatic retry after a dropped price write.
Guard covers commercial, price, inventory and shipping changes plus create selections.
boundary: Security/data-preservation behavior from tasks 283/284 is unchanged; cross-seller reads/writes remain 404/403 and seller shipping writes 403.

requirements.title: Real sales channel
positive: Offer list DTO carries the real Channel from the offer aggregate; both grids display it through the active catalog.
Channel is not filterable/sortable because the current server contract only supports the status filter and sellerSku/status/date sorts.
Create channel stays the project policy (Marketplace); no fabricated channel.
negative: Hardcoded accessor () => "Marketplace" removed.
boundary: List channel equals detail channel in runtime evidence.

requirements.title: Buyability
positive: deriveBuyability matches the existing domain/storefront heuristic (Active + price + available stock); no new purchasing logic was added.
UI labels it as a display indicator and explains that final confirmation happens in cart.
negative: The UI no longer presents the heuristic as a definitive purchase decision.
boundary: Reason codes map to readable copy; unknown reasons do not leak technical text.

requirements.title: Grid readability
positive: Shared AppDataGrid retained; product is first in logical order and actions last.
Product width, seller, SKU, Jalali/active-calendar date, price and stock are readable; row height is 64.
Human variant label is shown for the product; image uses object-fit cover.
Real search, sellerSku sort, page 2 and CSV export verified; status filter verified through the real query contract.
Saved views remain on the same grid keys.
negative: Unsupported product/channel/amount sorts are not exposed as false affordances.
boundary: 360/768/1440 overflow zero; grid remains shared infrastructure.
